get.description:
Organisations the signed-in user belongs to, most recently used first.

Switching is navigation: open ``url``. Each organisation is a separate security
context, so permissions never carry across.

post.description:
Submit (or ``{"skip": true}``) one wizard step; ``complete`` finishes the wizard.

Steps: business, locale, branding, service, tutors (teams/agencies), students,
payments, invoicing.

get.description:
Typed settings for one area, e.g. ``general`` or ``billing`` (FR-02-5).

``schema`` describes each setting so the frontend can render the form. With
``?branch=<id>``, ``values`` are the effective values for that branch and
``overrides`` lists the keys set at branch level.

parameters.name: branch
parameters.description: Branch id: read or override branch-level values.

parameters.name: branch

post.description:
Create an organisation, and a login for new people (FR-02-6).

Signed-in users may call it to add another organisation (no credentials needed).
Public, rate-limited per IP and protected by Cloudflare Turnstile.
